name: Staked Cap USD

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Explicit possible: the verified stcUSD UUPS proxy can replace its implementation through Cap's external AccessControl, one-day TimelockController, and 3-of-5 governance Safe. The active implementation has no direct holder restriction, but this bounded live authority can introduce one.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed 2026-07-15. At Ethereum safe block 25,535,489 (0x185a401; hash 0x5ecfd74206eab6171c6acac2c9b2d1a5c253f17c3178fb272b2db06ffb4bc57a), stcUSD asset() returned cUSD and EIP-1967 slots resolved the stcUSD proxy to 0x42c0e0ef7c2f35de073f4d6f9c0e4483429c3d31 and cUSD to 0xa76645e15c267b876999bf7689e0b2c1ee29bfe6. The verified StakedCap source has standard ERC-4626/ERC-20 transfer paths and no pause, blacklist, freeze, seize, or address-lock function; paused() reverted. The record's verified mint-authority observation at block 25,531,350 establishes the live UUPS upgrade path: external AccessControl, then a one-day TimelockController, then the Cap 3-of-5 governance Safe. This establishes a bounded governance-controlled future holder-control possibility, not a current direct blacklist. The verified cUSD implementation exposes protocol- and asset-level pause functions, which remain additive upstream exposure. Cap's terms and reserve dashboard provided no additional deployed holder-control mechanism. The official mechanics page has a 2026-06-22 archive capture.

mintAuthority.summary: stcUSD is an ERC-4626 UUPS wrapper over Cap cUSD. Wrapper minting remains deposit/share accounting with no separate privileged mint path, while live upgrade authority routes through Cap's external AccessControl and one-day TimelockController to the 3-of-5 Cap governance Safe. Durable cUSD mint authority is inherited from the reviewed Cap vault controls.

controls.label: stcUSD ERC-4626 UUPS wrapper
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531350, the EIP-1967 implementation slot returned 0x42c0e0ef7c2f35de073f4d6f9c0e4483429c3d31 (StakedCap) and the EIP-1967 admin slot was zero, confirming UUPS. asset() returned cUSD 0xcCcc62962d17b8914c62D74FfB843d73B2a3cccC. The verified ERC-4626 implementation mints wrapper shares through deposits and routes _authorizeUpgrade through checkAccess(bytes4(0)); the latter remains live through the external AccessControl and timelock path recorded in the governance Safe control.

controls.label: Cap Ethereum governance Safe through one-day timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531350, StakedCap's external AccessControl at 0x7731129a10d51e18cde607c5c115f26503d2c683 assigned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to TimelockController 0xd8236031d8279d82e615af2bfab5fc0127a329ab. The timelock retained its self-administered DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and had a minimum delay of 86400 seconds. Safe 0xb8FC49402dF3ee4f8587268FB89fda4d621a8793 held PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE, and CANCELLER_ROLE; it was 3-of-5 with the listed owners, no enabled modules, and a zero guard. The Safe can therefore authorize wrapper implementation changes after the one-day delay.

sources.label: Ethereum cUSD proxy and verified CapToken implementation

controls.evidence: The separately reviewed cUSD parent establishes this collateralized mint path at Ethereum block 25530492. stcUSD asset() resolves to that cUSD deployment, so base-asset issuance is inherited rather than administered by an undisclosed stcUSD minter.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531350, stcUSD remained an ERC-4626 UUPS wrapper whose asset() was cUSD 0xcCcc62962d17b8914c62D74FfB843d73B2a3cccC. Deposits mint wrapper shares through ERC-4626 accounting, while the verified StakedCap implementation authorizes upgrades through the external AccessControl contract. Its DEFAULT_ADMIN was the one-day TimelockController, which retained self-admin authority; the 3-of-5 Cap governance Safe actively held proposer, executor, and canceller roles and had no enabled modules. The wrapper upgrade path is live, while durable base-asset mint authority remains inherited from the separately reviewed cUSD parent.
